mission.mission_text: Our mission is to transform animal care into a living part of urban culture.
mission.mission_detail1: We believe that caring is a regenerative act, capable of transforming streets, people, and the planet. We create actions, products, and experiences that unite art, empathy, and action inspiring communities to protect the animals that share the city with us.
mission.mission_detail2: With Lil Feeder, we give shape to this purpose: care becomes visible, accessible, and collective.
mission.vision_text: We dream of kinder cities where art, care, and regeneration walk together.
mission.vision_goal: We visualize a future where there are no more animals on the streets and Stray Strong is no longer necessary.

partners.title: OUR PARTNERS
partners.subtitle: Building impact together
partners.partner1_description: A non-profit organization founded in 2023 with a mission to recover waste from nature and regenerate ecosystems.
partners.partner1_achievements: Since the beginning, we've removed over 12 tons of waste from beaches, rivers, and lagoons through more than 200 professional clean-up actions, all made possible through collective funding.
partners.partner2_description: A social-environmental enterprise focused on raising awareness about plastic use and offering innovative, reusable solutions for its management.
partners.partner2_achievements: The organization provides consultancy, workshops, and innovation-driven projects, transforming discarded plastic into great products, while promoting decentralized and collective recycling.
partners.partner3_description: An open and horizontal collective based in Saquarema, focused on building strategic partnerships between local projects, NGOs, companies, and cultural or environmental initiatives.
partners.partner3_achievements: We're in an early-stage journey to become a DAO rooted in community, regeneration, and creativity.
partners.footer: Together, we're creating a more regenerative future.
